Intel 2022 net income 8.014B, diluted EPS 1.94. 2023 diluted EPS was $0.40? Let's compute: net income 1,689, shares ~4.2B, EPS ~0.40. Yes 2023 EPS was $0.40. The chunk says diluted EPS 4.50 — implausible, contradicts net income. So false_data. Also repeated risk factors, but that's not necessarily flag. The EPS 4.50 is clearly wrong. Flag true, category false_data.
